title: Ernst Steinitz: Modern LaTeX Transcriptions and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Steinitz author lane from corpus package 20
description:
Dedicated Ernst Steinitz author record for modern LaTeX transcriptions, English translation drafts, source witnesses, and QA artifacts. Current public readers cover selected work from 1894, 1897, 1899, 1901, 1905, 1910, 1911, and the opening of the 1912 Rectangular Systems II paper.

Status at a glance. The 1894 dissertation material is complete in paired German and English working readers. The 1897, 1899, 1901, 1905, 1910, and 1911 readers are delivered as paired German and English working files. The 1910 Algebraic Theory of Fields reader is current through sections 1-24. The 1912 Rectangular Systems II item is now started in paired German/English working readers for printed pages 297-315, with the full printed-page 297-345 source slice included for checking and continuation. The ZIP artifact preserves TeX, TXT, source scans/source PDFs, render checks, checksums, and package notes.

Latest update. Promotes corpus package 20: refreshes the 1910 field-theory readers through sections 1-24, adds the first German/English 1912 Rectangular Systems II readers for pp. 297-315, keeps the full pp. 297-345 source slice, and refreshes the source/witness ZIP. The 1906 Euler polyhedron-relations note and 1908 Beitrage zur Analysis Situs remain on the source-intake follow-up list.
notes: Corpus package 20 refreshes the 1910 field-theory readers through sections 1-24, adds paired German/English 1912 Rectangular Systems II partial readers for pp. 297-315, keeps the full pp. 297-345 source slice, and refreshes the source/witness ZIP. Remaining source-intake follow-up: the 1906 Euler polyhedron-relations note and the 1908 Beitrage zur Analysis Situs.
